description: ​Alpha Space Assistant is a voice-enabled, multi-agency space exploration guide built entirely on a smartphone. Powered by Gemini and ElevenLabs, it breaks language barriers in space education, synthesizing cosmic data from global and private space agencies into real-time voice responses across multiple languages. Built by a solo developer from India using limited resources, it proves that space intelligence requires just a phone, a powerful idea, and the will to never quit.
